Frontend.reason: Tracker Writing Correction offers an optional deep-analysis mode that clearly costs two daily quota units. Learners can provide the exact task as text or a locally compressed image, receive a compact report tied to explicit prompt requirements and verbatim essay evidence, and see a clear refund message when recognition fails. The client now gives only schemaVersion 4 deep analysis a 95-second transport window, while ordinary AI remains at 30 seconds and standard writing remains at 55 seconds; the pending UI preserves the draft and lets the learner continue browsing. A valid deep report may explicitly show that no stable recurring pattern had enough exact evidence, instead of forcing a possibly invented pattern. All five managed-AI entry points show quota consistently; daily suggestions, learning analysis and plan drafts also disable explicit generation while quota is loading, disabled or exhausted. Prepared plan text is filled into the editor instead of being submitted automatically.

Backend.reason: The companion Lexi branch provides backward-compatible writing submission V4 validation, server-side two-unit metering, multimodal routing and atomic two-unit refunds for failed prompt recognition or unsupported image routes. The optional deep route now has an 88-second total provider budget for one bounded structure repair, still below the dedicated 95-second client window. Completed provider output is conservatively projected into the exact contract when a display subsection or evidence identifier is malformed; exact submitted evidence remains mandatory, and recurring patterns may be empty when unsupported. It stores only quota and request-receipt metadata; the prompt image, essay and report are not persisted in Supabase. Existing V2 and V3 writing submissions remain accepted.

Admin.reason: The companion Lexi Control branch adds purpose-specific writing policy controls for daily quota units, request bytes, output tokens and route selection, plus visible image-capability and refund semantics. Other Words and Tracker policy cards keep their existing behavior.

Deployment.reason: The 95-second deep-analysis transport adjustment and matching 88-second backend repair budget are being verified together. Deploy the exact verified Tracker commit to the Direct Upload Pages project and the exact companion Lexi commit to the AI gateway before repeating production model acceptance.
